Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) during the incident window
candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; traces and logs show the order service erroring on every checkout attempt.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and its dependency (inventory, payment, postgresql) telemetry are absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are fully explained by order returning 500 on POST /v1/orders in traces and logs; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). The specific order-side fault (pool exhaustion, redis timeout, downstream latency) is not established by current evidence, so only the bounded http-500 candidate is offered.
missing_evidence: Order service server-side error details for the 500 responses
